otherSourcesFound.what: Official Kivanc datasheet cover for TOPCON 610-640W. It is the listing-page image for that line, so the brief's claim that no image exists is wrong. The SVG has outlined text, so it must be rendered to read (I used macOS qlmanage). It prints QUANTUM TOPCON Series, KVNC-XXXB-66H-GGT, 610-640W, 23.69% maximum efficiency, 12-year/30-year warranties, 0~+5W, and Dual-Sided Power Generation. I transcribed the kivanc-topcon-610-640 record from it.

English listing page. Its six cover images under https://www.kivancsolar.com/_en/assets/uploads/products/products/list/ (246_..., 377_yen228176-..._bifacial..., 581_..._610-640w_1.svg, 769_blackseries1.jpg, 781_yen228176-..._monofacial..., 791_glass-_glass1.jpg) are byte-identical (MD5) to the Turkish ones, so they add no new data. The EN product pages (/en/products/solar-panels/<slug>) all show "Content not found."

CSA Certificate of Compliance 80146608 (2023-04-28), issued to Kivanc Enerji Uretim A.S. The same content is at https://www.kivancsolar.com/_en/assets/uploads/certificates/detail/505_cofc80146608en.pdf. It covers model series KVNC-xxxM-72H-GBF (520-560), 66H-GBF (475-510), 60H-GBF (435-465) and 54H-GBF (390-420), with a maximum system voltage of 1500 V dc and a 25 A fuse rating. This is a certificate, not a datasheet, and its codes do not exactly match any cover (the Black cover prints 54B-GBF, not 54H-GBF), so I did not transcribe from it.

Certificates page with other PDFs/images: TUV cert (137_tuv_cert.pdf), TUV Nord (145_t227188v_nord.pdf), ammonia, PID and salt spray certificates (293_/324_/668_...pdf), and CSA (77_csa.pdf). None of them is a product datasheet.

ENF Solar third-party panel-datasheet pages for Kivanc Solar (also .../66747 and .../66748), found by web search. They returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch. They are not official Kivanc documents and I did not use them.

Listing page (HTTP 200). No PDF, katalog or download links. The /katalog, /kataloglar, /dokumanlar, /indir, /downloads, /download, /e-katalog and /teknik-dokumanlar paths all 302-redirect to the homepage. /sitemap.xml returns 500 and robots.txt is empty. The detail/big/original/gallery variants of the product image folders redirect to the homepage. Guessed page-2 datasheet filenames do not exist.
